headline: Double-digit annual growth, sequential momentum cools
summary_short: Visa's fiscal Q2 2026 revenue rose to $11.63B (+14.4% y/y) and diluted EPS climbed to $2.97 (+10.4% y/y), though results eased versus the prior quarter with EPS down 5.4% q/q and net income of $5.63B down 6.5% q/q.
summary_long: Revenue of $11.63B rose 14.4% y/y and 3.6% q/q. Operating income of $7.13B gained 15.4% y/y but eased 1.4% q/q. Gross profit of $8.90B rose 8.5% y/y, down 2.6% q/q. EBIT ($7.03B, +10.3% y/y) and EBITDA ($7.39B, +10.5% y/y) each fell about 4% q/q. Net income of $5.63B rose 6.8% y/y but fell 6.5% q/q. Diluted EPS of $2.97 gained 10.4% y/y, down 5.4% q/q.
